is_anopheles.evidence: The study assessed insecticide resistance and mechanisms in wild Anopheles gambiae sensu lato (s.l.) populations, including Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles arabiensis across mainland Tanzania.

reports_target_markers.evidence: Assayed for voltage-gated sodium channel mutations: kdr L1014S (east mutation, Vgsc L995S) and L1014F (west mutation, Vgsc L995F) using qPCR.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 2, 3, and 4 report sample sizes (N), genotype counts (RR, RS, SS), and allelic frequencies (R) for L1014S and L1014F mutations in An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis across multiple sentinel districts for 2019 and 2020.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae or adults from field sentinel sites across 71 districts in mainland Tanzania between 2004 and 2020.

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research presenting longitudinal national surveillance data, including previously unpublished primary genotype and bioassay monitoring data (2016-2020) collected by NIMR/NMCP.

sub_country_location.evidence: Genotype data are resolved to specific sentinel districts including Kilosa, Geita, Kilwa, Kakonko, Ukerewe, Newala, Meatu, Tandahimba, Kasulu, Tunduru, Kibondo, Misenyi, Nachingwea, Biharamuro, Bukoba DC, Kigoma DC, Ngara, and Ruangwa.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Genotype counts and bioassays are reported per individual survey year (e.g., 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2019, 2020).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper compiles longitudinal surveillance data from 2004 to 2020. Data from earlier years (2004, 2009, 2011, 2012, 2015) were published in previous studies (Kabula et al. 2012, 2014; Kisinza et al. 2017), while data from 2016-2020 come from unpublished NIMR technical reports.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts (N, RR, RS, SS) and allelic frequencies per site for target markers are provided directly in Tables 2, 3, and 4 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study analyzes longitudinal monitoring data (2004-2020) on insecticide susceptibility, resistance intensity, PBO synergy, species composition, and kdr marker frequencies (L1014S and L1014F) in Anopheles gambiae s.l. across sentinel districts in mainland Tanzania. Detailed genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and allele frequencies for L1014S and L1014F in An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis are provided for 2019 and 2020.
